params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: Photos uploaded in order to a new vehicle come back with the first five or six out of place, the rest in order. Every new car with numbered file names gets a wrong main photo and gallery until the garage drags them back.

## What is wrong

A garage uploaded the photos of a new vehicle in the order it wanted. On the photo tab the first five or six stood out of order; the others were right.

The uploader sends the files one at a time, in the order they were picked, and `upload_dropzone` numbers them in that order. But when a vehicle had no photos yet, two places then re-sort them by file name (R S1-6.3):

- `ImageController::reset_image_order`, called by the uploader when the batch is done;
- `OwnStockController::create`, on the next open of the sheet, when the first photo has `sort_order` 0.

Both sort with MySQL `ORDER BY name`, which compares character by character. Windows Explorer and the macOS Finder sort numbers by value. For files named `1.jpg` to `14.jpg` the garage sees 1, 2, 3 ... 14 in its folder, and the platform stores 1, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 2, 3 ... 9: the first six places shuffled, and from 2 on it looks right again. That matches the report.

## What should happen

The order after the first upload is the order the garage sees in its own folder: file names compared the way a person reads them, numbers by value (`2` before `10`), case ignored. Upload order breaks a tie.

The sort on file name stays: it keeps the order independent of the order a file dialog or a drag hands the files over in. The file names of this vehicle were not read (no production access from here); the numbered-name case is the one that produces exactly this pattern.

Source: Portal mail:69.
params.title: Photos uploaded to a new vehicle are sorted by file name character by character, so 10 comes before 2
